title: fix(core): compareTo on a forward date range (next month, next quarter, next 30 days) compares with the period just before it, not with itself
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB727BBWue3wvnPrGZkDgyYY)_

Fixes #30140

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：指标卡开启「与上一周期对比」时，日期范围选「下月」「下季度」「未来 30 天」不再拿窗口和自己比。下月对比本月，下季度对比本季度，未来 30 天（今天起共 31 天）对比截至昨天的 31 天；趋势文字随之改为「较本月」「较本季度」「较上期」。新增两个文案键，10 种语言都已补齐。
- 为什么改：#30133 加了这三个前向预设，但前端的对比逻辑只会把「本期」换成「上期」，前向窗口原样不动，所以涨跌永远是 0%，文字还写成「较上月」。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `compare-to.ts` 的一个纯函数和文案。其余 13 个预设的对比窗口与文字逐字节不变（新加对照钉住，另在 8 个参考日期上整表比对 main 与本分支一致）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/core/src/utils/compare-to.ts` 的 `forwardRollingPair` / `shiftForwardRollingWindows`（滚动窗口怎么认、怎么平移）；② 同文件 `PREVIOUS_PERIOD_TOKENS` 为什么一次替换（两次会把下月一路推到上月）；③ `compareToTrendLabelKey` 里前向判断排在后向判断之前。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.presetWindows-29116.test.ts`，预期 16 个预设各有一条对比用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/core` `shiftFilterByCompareTo`, `kind: 'previousPeriod'`.** It substituted only `current_*` / `today` tokens. The forward presets are spelled `{next_month_start}`…`{next_month_end}`, `{next_quarter_start}`…`{next_quarter_end}` and `{today}`…`{30_days_from_now}` (`DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS`), so the first two compared the window with itself and the third moved only its start (`{yesterday}`…`{30_days_from_now}`, a 32-day window overlapping the current one). Now:
  - `NEXT_TO_CURRENT_TOKENS` maps `next_month_*` / `next_quarter_*` to `current_*`. It is merged with `CURRENT_TO_LAST_TOKENS` into one map applied in ONE pass; a second pass would carry `next_month_start` on to `last_month_start`.
  - A `{today}` + `{N_days_from_now}` pair inside one field's operator object (or a two-member `$between`) moves back by its own length, N + 1 days: `{(N+1)_days_ago}` … `{yesterday}`. This runs first, so the generic `today` → `yesterday` swap never sees that `{today}`. A lone `{today}`, a lone `{N_days_from_now}`, and two FIELDS holding those tokens keep today's reading.
  - `next_week_start` / `next_year_start` are not mapped: the macro vocabulary has no `_end` partner for them, so no preset or closed window uses them.
- **`compareToTrendLabelKey`** names the window really compared: `vsThisMonth`, `vsThisQuarter`, and `vsPreviousPeriod` for a forward rolling window (it read `vsLastMonth`, `vsLastQuarter`, `vsYesterday`). Each forward check sits before the backward pattern that also matches it (`quarter_start` is inside `next_quarter_start`).
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: `dashboard.trend.vsThisMonth` / `vsThisQuarter` in all ten locale packs (zh 较本月 / 较本季度). No other existing key fits: `vsLastMonth` names the wrong month, and `vsPreviousPeriod` is used where it is exact (the rolling window).
- **English fallbacks** for the two keys in `ObjectMetricWidget`, `MetricWidget` (its defaults table and its phrase-to-key map) and `ObjectChart`'s comparison-series label; `plugin-dashboard/SKILL.md`'s label table gains the three rows.

## Why

Issue #30140: a should-fix from the contract review of #30133. The governing text is the `compare-to.ts` docblock: "`kind: 'previousPeriod'` — the equal-length window immediately before the current one". No spec change, no new `compareTo` kind, no new preset.

## Tests

- `compare-to.test.ts`: next month → this month, next quarter → this quarter (also across a year boundary, from 2026-12-10), `{today}`…`{30_days_from_now}` → the 31 days ending yesterday, a `$between` rolling window, and the cases that must NOT move (lone tokens, two fields). Label keys for all three, under `previousPeriod` and `previousYear`.
- `dashboard-filters.presetWindows-29116.test.ts`: the compareTo case now runs on all 16 presets, with a completeness pin. Each preset pins both kinds' windows and the label at 2026-07-15. Forward presets also assert, on all six reference dates, that the previous window ends the day before the current one starts (equal length for `next_30_days`, starting on the 1st for the calendar ones).
- **CONTROL**: `RETIRED_COMPARE_AT_REFERENCE` holds the 13 earlier presets' windows and labels read off `compare-to.ts` at `b7075d99` before the fix; the retired-spelling equivalence still runs on all six dates.
- `ObjectMetricWidget.compareTo.forwardPresets-30140.test.tsx` (rendered): the registered `object-metric` block with each forward preset's window and `compareTo: previousPeriod`. The data source answers 120 for the current window, 100 only for the expected previous window, 7 otherwise; the tile shows `20%` and the right label, and not the stale one.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the inline path is reached (measured).** A dashboard `metric` widget is dataset-bound: `DashboardRenderer` routes it to `DatasetWidget`, and the comparison is shifted by the analytics executor (`shiftRange`), labelled from `compareTo.kind` alone (`vsPreviousPeriod`). `shiftFilterByCompareTo` runs in `ObjectMetricWidget` (the `object-metric` block) and in `ObjectChart` (a `provider: 'object'` series widget, which the dashboard date filter is broadcast into). Those are the surfaces this PR changes.
- **The executor on forward presets (measured, not changed).** `tsx` probe of `lowerDatasetCompareDateRange` + `inclusiveCalendarDayWindow` + `shiftRange` with the clock at 2026-07-15: `next_month` 2026-08-01..08-31 → 2026-07-01..07-31; `next_quarter` 2026-10-01..12-31 → 2026-07-01..09-30; `next_30_days` 2026-07-15..08-14 → 2026-06-14..07-14. No forward window compares with itself, and `next_30_days` matches this PR's inline window exactly. The executor counts days, so a forward month of 30 days (2026-09-01..09-30) compares with 2026-08-02..08-31, not calendar August; that is its rule for every preset (`this_month` 2026-07-01..07-31 → 2026-05-31..06-30), not a forward-preset defect.
- **Pre-existing, kept by the control on purpose (out of scope):** on the inline path `yesterday`, `last_week`, `last_month`, `last_quarter` and `last_year` compare with themselves (no `last_*` token is shifted; e.g. `last_month` at 2026-07-15 → 2026-06-01..06-30), and `last_N_days` compares an N + 1 day window with N days. `previousYear` from a leap day re-resolves at 2027-03-01, so `this_month` on 2028-02-29 compares with March 2027.
- **Why a rendered unit check instead of a browser screenshot.** The fix is a pure function between the filter and the second aggregate. The rendered test drives the real registered block, its real aggregate calls and its real trend badge, and pins the exact previous window the browser would query. A dashboard `metric` widget in the console would exercise the dataset path, which this PR does not touch.

## Verification

<details><summary>Suites, type-check, lint, ablations</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/<pkg>/` under `os-verify-lock`: core exit 0, i18n exit 0, plugin-dashboard exit 0 (201 files, 1,925 passed, 6 skipped), plugin-charts exit 0 (103 files, 1,333 passed, 9 skipped).
- `pnpm run type-check` in core, i18n, plugin-dashboard and plugin-charts: exit 0 each.
- `npx eslint` on every touched file: 0 errors (warnings only, `no-explicit-any`, as in the surrounding code).
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): previousPeriod back to `substituteTokens(filter, CURRENT_TO_LAST_TOKENS)` → 11 failed / 70 passed across the three test files (every forward-window pin, the three forward 29116 rows, the three rendered rows); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2: drop the `next_quarter_` label check → 3 failed (label pin, the `next_quarter` 29116 row, the rendered `next_quarter` row); restored.
- CONTROL measured outside the tests: a `tsx` probe of all 16 presets × 8 reference dates × both kinds plus labels, on `main` and on this branch — the 13 earlier presets' output is byte-identical; only the three forward presets change.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 35): see the report on #30140.

</details>
